title: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
summary: An open-source orchestration system that turns tickets into merged PRs using AI coding agents (Claude Code/Codex). Handles full lifecycle: intake, execution (K8s), CI monitoring, and squash-merge.

title: Agent Package Manager (APM) for Agent Configuration
summary: Microsoft/GitHub tool to manage agent dependencies (plugins, skills, rules) with a lockfile. Scans for supply-chain attacks and hidden unicode. Targets Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor.

title: Sweet! CLI – Cheaper alternative to Claude Code or Codex CLI
summary: Usage-based agent CLI with 'autopilot' for monitoring live applications and detecting outages.

title: Urlx – an agent-made Rust replacement for curl/libcurl
summary: Claude Code reimplemented curl in Rust in days by iterating on the existing test suite as a spec. Converged on 100% pass rate autonomously.

title: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
summary: Unified security and governance layer for agents. Mentions specific OpenClaw support (gateway hardening, cognitive drift monitoring).

title: AI agent browser bot took over live dashboard for 45 minutes
summary: Viral thread detailing a production incident where an unmonitored AI agent took over a live dashboard. Discussion focuses on lack of explicit decision logging and incident control authority.

title: Developer fired for AI-generated code breaking production
summary: Techie fired after blindly trusting AI code that broke production. Manager also relied on AI for the merge. Highlights the risk of 'unsupervised' AI merges.
